name: agent-memory
description: Workspace root: unifies the ui/ component library + standalone app and scripts/ dev tooling under npm workspaces

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agent-memory/ui && npm run build --workspace @agent-memory/app
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @agent-memory/ui && npm run test --workspace @agent-memory/app
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace @agent-memory/ui && npm run format --workspace @agent-memory/app
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace @agent-memory/ui && npm run format:check --workspace @agent-memory/app
